root: Customer sync: Harbor CRM and Ledgerline Billing

groups.name: Fields synced
groups.items: 14 on Accounts, 8 on Contacts: name, addresses, payment terms, credit limit, the account owner

groups.name: Automations
groups.items: On create and edit of an account or a billing contact: post the record to the billing API

groups.name: Rules
groups.items: Credit limit read-only once billing has invoiced · billing contact required for active accounts · no deleting an account with open invoices

groups.name: Access
groups.items: Integration user (API only) · permission set for the billing fields

groups.name: Access
groups.items: API key scoped to customers and invoices, read and write

groups.name: CRM to billing
groups.items: Each saved account or billing contact is upserted by its `crm_account_id`

groups.name: Billing to CRM
groups.items: Webhooks update `Billing_Status` and `Last_Synced`; overdue invoices open a task for the owner

groups.name: Nightly reconcile
groups.items: Compares every active customer on both sides and repairs differences

groups.name: Shared ids
groups.items: CRM account id in `crm_account_id` · billing customer id in `Billing_Customer_ID`

groups.name: Credentials
groups.items: CRM integration user's OAuth client · billing API key, rotated every 90 days

groups.name: Monitoring
groups.items: Failed calls email the ops inbox, with the record and the error

groups.name: Planned
groups.items: Retry for failed webhooks · the initial load of 40,000 customers · an alert when the nightly reconcile fails
